snippet.title: Dora: Rainforest Rescue | Announce Trailer | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
🎒 Grab your backpack, 🗺️ find your map, and 📣 tell your kids. Dora: Rainforest Rescue is coming to consoles and PC on October 24th 🎮 🌳!
✨ Your child will go on an interactive adventure with their amigos, Dora and Boots, playing in solo or local co-op mode.
✨ Watch your kid laugh, dance and complete challenges with Ale, Tico, Isa, Benny, and Big Red Chicken.
✨ They will discover secret paths in the rainforest to unlock new areas and skills, collect items and earn crystals.

Want to find out more about the game? ¡Vámonos! Let’s go! www.outrightgames.com/games/dora-rainforest-rescue/
#DoraRainforestRescue #Dora #nickjrpartyadventures
